adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: the `sub` ids every row we own keys on (auth.users.id), which must arrive at the target UNCHANGED. Export: auth.users, auth.identities and the password hashes (encrypted_password) by pg_dump of the auth schema — the 2026-09-24 hosted-to-Box-C method, same ids. Cannot move: refresh tokens; every session is re-issued, so each user signs in again after a cutover.
Nothing leaves: the fake holds its accounts in memory for one test and has no record to export.
Nothing leaves: the demo identity holds its users in memory for the life of the process and has no record to export.

issuers.why: The one identity project (ADR 062: ES256 through JWKS only, INV-406). A cutover's dual-issuer window (the 2026-09-24 hosted-to-Box-C precedent) is a SECOND row naming the other origin's variable; a token whose issuer no row names is refused before any key set is fetched. This row reads SUPABASE_URL (the schema requires it of row 0). At the cutover SUPABASE_URL moves to the target and the second row's variable holds the OLD origin, which stays trusted until the oldest supported app build has rotated and a further jwt_exp has passed (review of #1182, finding 2).

_why: dart L3 (port-auth, 2026-10-03): the app reads AuthRepository only; the composition root (authRepositoryProvider) picks SupabaseAuthRepository or the in-memory demo identity from AppConfig.isBackendLive, and C-5 (assert-package-boundaries.mjs) refuses an app importing the Supabase SDK around the seam. runAuthRepositoryConformance (packages/core/lib/testing.dart) passes for SupabaseAuthRepository over GoTrue's wire answers (packages/auth_supabase/test/fixtures/gotrue_wire.json) and for FakeAuthRepository, with nothing pending: a wrong password, an offline request and a throttled one keep three codes (O-REAUTH-READS-NETWORK-FAILURE-AS-WRONG-PASSWORD is not reproduced at the seam). The in-memory demo identity is not run against the suite: it never validates a password by design.

ts L2: every call a Worker makes to the identity provider on its own credential is a verb of IdentityAdmin (services/_shared/src/ports/identity.ts), built by the gotrue adapter (services/platform/src/adapters/identity/gotrue.ts, inside the entry Worker because assert-erasure-reach.mjs limb 6 keeps the one identity deleter there) and reached only through identityFor (services/platform/src/ports.ts). assert-ports limb 4 refuses an identity-provider URL built anywhere else in services/*/src. Not L3: identity-port.test.ts holds both adapters to the same answers but is not a registered suite runner.

The trusted issuers are config (`issuers`, rendered into services/_shared/src/generated/ports.ts and resolved by services/_shared/src/auth.ts trustedIssuers). Token verification is JWKS + ES256 by protocol; the issuer list is what a cutover edits.

The Supabase URL and anon key are public build configuration on the client (dart-defines classified build-config in tooling/channel-register.json, read as AppConfig.authEndpoint and authPublicKey), so the Dart adapters declare no secret; the Worker adapter declares the service-role key and the anon key (the keep-alive) by name.
